about.subtitle: Multi-dimensional syntactic complexity analysis toolkit
about.description: SynSpectra is a multi-dimensional syntactic complexity analysis toolkit for English text corpora. It integrates custom dependency-distance metrics (MDD/NDD/MHDD/AlphaDepLength), a Python reimplementation of the LeoDDcalculator formulas (MDD_Leo/NDD_Leo), QuanSyn dependency & valency metrics, and the NeoSCA/L2SCA family — providing a reproducible batch pipeline for quantitative linguistics, L2 writing research and mental-health text analysis.
about.leoNoteTitle: Important note about the Leo metrics
about.leoNoteEn: The MDD_Leo / NDD_Leo metrics in this project are NOT produced by calling the LeoDDcalculator R package. They are our own Python reimplementation of its formulas on top of UDPipe (per-sentence MDD excluding root/punct, NDD = abs(log(mdd / sqrt(sentence_length × root_distance)))), so they can be compared directly with the custom and QuanSyn MDD/NDD values.
